h: Peller shocks everyone as he brings his ex-girlfriend who never believed in him onto TikTok Live!
p: Streamer Peller has got fans talking after reportedly bringing an ex-girlfriend, said to have doubted him before his rise to fame, onto his TikTok Live. The surprise moment has drawn a flood of reactions online, coming just weeks after his much-discussed clashes with his wife, fellow streamer Jarvis.
more: Fans are divided over whether the moment was sweet revenge or just good content.
Peller has become one of Nigeria's biggest live streamers in the past year.
Neither Jarvis nor the ex-girlfriend has commented publicly.
